lines.text: The commander wants the real reason for the accusation, so he brings Paul before the Sanhedrin, and Paul says his conscience has been good.
The high priest Ananias orders Paul struck on the mouth, and Paul says he did not know the man was high priest.
Paul says he is a Pharisee on trial over the resurrection, and the Pharisees and Sadducees split because the Pharisees deny it.

wrong_details.true: the Sadducees say there is no resurrection, while the Pharisees acknowledge it

lines.text: Scribes from the Pharisees say they find nothing wrong with Paul, and the commander has soldiers take him into the temple.
The following night the Lord stands near Paul and tells him to take courage, because he must testify in Rome.
